item.title: Kubra Commander unleashes genre-bending 3rd album 'Metabolic' — listen
item.description: Cebu indie artist Kubra Commander is back with a sonic surge — unveiling his third studio album Metabolic, out now on all platforms. Metabolic is a 12-track deep dive into Bobbi Olvido’s eclectic soundscape, brimming with indie rock grit, post-Britpop flair, funk grooves, and pulses of electronica.
